title: PepMod: Peptide Tracker
shortDescription: Track protocols, dose logs, progress, reminders, and vial calculations.
fullDescription:
PepMod keeps your peptide tracking organised in one private workspace. Build protocols, record completed or skipped doses, review adherence and progress, and schedule reminders.

Use the educational peptide library and unit-conversion tools to record vial and syringe values you enter. PepMod does not prescribe doses, diagnose conditions, or replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional.

Your account keeps your protocol history available across supported devices.
